name: nori
description: A light identity for a plant-forward lunch spot. A curled seaweed mark, gentle mint, and a sharp little splash of salmon balance organic warmth with urban energy.
heading: rubik
rules: The kelp mark is one continuous silhouette.
Organize menus into softly bounded bento-like modules.
Use ginger to highlight seasonal items, never to imply warnings.

system.concept: Sculptural vegetable cutouts, playful bento compartments, small ingredient labels, and crisp friendly type. The food itself becomes a highly graphic visual language.
headline: Good eating.
Fresh perspective.
features: A bright menu that starts with the good things in season.
Simple combinations with a considered balance.
Food for the everyday that still feels like a small pleasure.
system.layoutNote: Rice hero with an asymmetrical bento artwork and rounded, clearly separated ingredient panels. Kelp text on rice; ginger highlights seasonal items.
